UGA.note: URSB says no government-wide digital signature platform exists and it is only engaging NITA-U; nothing authorised, contracted or in service.

facts.fact: URSB told Parliament's COSASE committee on 10 November 2026 that its Online Business Registration System (OBRS), which the Auditor General found down for long periods between August 2023 and September 2025, now has 99% availability and processes services such as certification instantly.

The Auditor General flagged URSB's exposure of full dates of birth in business records as contrary to the requirements of the Data Protection and Privacy Act, as heard by Parliament's COSASE committee on 10 November 2026.

UGA.note: Document states nothing about an electronic transactions or e-commerce law.
Only URSB's own ISO 9001:2015 certificate is stated, which places nothing.
Document does not say who runs or maintains OBRS or any other system.
Document states nothing about civil registration.
